data.narrative:
Ark Robotics is a seed-stage company in the Defense & Security sector. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 private and 2 public companies operating in robotics and autonomous systems for defense applications, including peers such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

The peer-median method was the applicable triangulation approach, drawing on four same-sector companies at seed and series A stages: UFORCE ($1.0B), Stark Defence ($4.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M). This cohort yields a median valuation of $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. The wide dispersion reflects stage and maturity variance within the defense robotics segment, where capital intensity and government contract potential drive significant valuation heterogeneity.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation band of $595M to $805M, centered on $700M. Key uncertainties include the absence of disclosed funding history for Ark Robotics, limited visibility into revenue or customer traction, and the inherent volatility of early-stage defense-tech valuations tied to contract wins and regulatory approval. The peer set skews toward series A and later-stage companies; the single seed-stage comparable (UFORCE at $1.0B) sits materially above the cohort median, suggesting Ark's profile may warrant positioning toward the lower end of the derived range pending evidence of differentiated technical capability or secured contracts.
